description: Structural validation of every component file against the Copilot Studio authoring schema (kinds, unknown/missing properties, duplicate ids, placeholders, Power Fx prefixes, variable scopes) plus cross-file checks (connection references, topic redirects). Answers 'is anything broken in these files?'; it only reads them and sends nothing anywhere. cs_push runs it itself and blocks on errors.

file.description: Validate a single file (relative to workspace)

workspace.description: Path to (or inside) the agent workspace. Defaults to CPS_WORKSPACE or the current directory.

name: cs_validate
title: Validate workspace YAML
